_purpose: Authoritative OLM metadata for the two RHOAI packages behind Tranche 4 blocker B1, captured as an ACQUISITION step in v2.1 Tranche 4A and committed so tests can consume it without network access (runbook Rule 6: no test may reach the network). Answers one question with catalog facts rather than inference: is `rhods-prometheus-operator` omitted, renamed or replaced at 4.22? Analysis lives in TRANCHE_4_PRE_FLIP_VERIFICATION.md; this file is evidence only.

dependencyProperties.note: Zero dependency properties on ANY bundle of this package at 4.20, 4.21 or 4.22. rhods-operator has never declared an OLM-resolvable dependency, so OLM would never have pulled rhods-prometheus-operator in.

vendoredPrometheusImageHistory.note: Every rhods-operator bundle from 1.20.1-8 through 3.0.0 carries four registry.redhat.io/openshift4/ose-prometheus-* relatedImages. Bundles 3.2.0 and later carry none (there is no 3.1.x bundle in any of the three indexes). Those images were vendored INSIDE the rhods-operator bundle; they are not the rhods-prometheus-operator package. The same boundary holds identically at 4.20, 4.21 and 4.22.

rhods-prometheus-operator.note: A single frozen 2021-vintage bundle, published only on a `beta` channel, carried forward unchanged at 4.20 and 4.21 (identical SHA256) and dropped at 4.22. It is a standalone Prometheus operator, not an OpenShift AI component, and no rhods-operator bundle references it.

documentation._note: Fetched 2026-10-08. Red Hat OpenShift AI Self-Managed 3.x is the stream whose operator (`stable-3.x`) the 4.22 catalog carries.

sources.title: Deploy or decommission OpenShift AI in disconnected environments (RHOAI Self-Managed 3.3)
findings: The ImageSetConfiguration example names exactly one OpenShift AI package: `rhods-operator`.
The string `prometheus` does not occur anywhere in the document (both halves checked).

Dependent operators named for 3.x components: cert-manager, Red Hat build of Kueue, Red Hat OpenShift Service Mesh 3.x, Llama Stack, Red Hat Connectivity Link, Red Hat Leader Worker Set, Node Feature Discovery, NVIDIA GPU Operator.

disposition.notRenamed: No 4.22 package carries the bundle image `rhods/odh-prometheus-bundle-rhel8`, and `odf-prometheus-operator` is an OpenShift Data Foundation component with a different provider and purpose. No replacement is claimed, because no evidence supports one.
disposition.notADependency: rhods-operator declares zero OLM dependency properties at every minor examined, so omitting the package cannot break operator resolution.
